title: Odd-symmetrized BLR acceptance identity
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$ and every real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube with values in $[-1,1]$, the acceptance probability of the original BLR tester after independently symmetrizing each of its three queries by a uniform random sign flip equals the acceptance probability of the zero-noise Håstad tester (the odd BLR tester) on $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
